Interface FormPart

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface FormPart extends AutoCloseable
A part of a form read with FormParts: a text field, or a file of a multipart/form-data form.

The content can be consumed once, with text(), text(int), text(int, Charset), bytes(int), transferTo(Path), transferTo(OutputStream) or takeBody(), or through the file() view, which shares the content and the lifecycle of the part: consuming or closing one consumes or closes the other. See FileUpload for the rules of consumption and closing.

The part is owned by the consumer callback it was given to: when the stage the callback returned completes, what was not consumed is discarded and an operation that is still running is aborted, before the next part is read. The callback must therefore return the stage of its work:

parts.part("file", part -> part.file().transferTo(destination))

A FormPart argument of a controller method is released like the reads of an AsyncRequestBody: an operation on its content that is still running when the method completed, normally or exceptionally, is aborted before the response is written, or, for a streamed response, when its stream ended. The method must therefore return the stage of its work on the part. Content the method did not read is discarded when the request ends.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • text

      CompletionStage<String> text()
      Read the whole content as text, with the limit of the server for buffered request content (micronaut.server.max-request-buffer-size). The charset is that of the part: the charset parameter of its content type, else the charset of the request (the charset of its content type, else the default charset of the server). Use text(int, Charset) to choose the charset. Malformed input is replaced, like in the text fields of a collected form.
      Returns:
      Completes with the content
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the content was already consumed, or the part closed

    • text

      CompletionStage<String> text(int maximumBytes)
      Read the whole content as text, in the charset of the part, see text().
      Parameters:
      maximumBytes - The maximum number of bytes to read, not characters, zero or more
      Returns:
      Completes with the content, or exceptionally with a ContentLengthExceededException when the content is larger than the limit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the limit is negative
      IllegalStateException - if the content was already consumed, or the part closed

    • text

      CompletionStage<String> text(int maximumBytes, Charset charset)
      Read the whole content as text, in the given charset, whatever the content type of the part or of the request says. Malformed input is replaced.
      Parameters:
      maximumBytes - The maximum number of bytes to read, not characters, zero or more
      charset - The charset of the content
      Returns:
      Completes with the content, or exceptionally with a ContentLengthExceededException when the content is larger than the limit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the limit is negative
      IllegalStateException - if the content was already consumed, or the part closed
      NullPointerException - if the charset is null

    • transferTo

      CompletionStage<Void> transferTo(OutputStream out)
      Write the content to a stream, a text field as well as a file, on the thread that delivers the content, usually an I/O thread of the server: the stream must not block, see FileUpload.transferTo(OutputStream). The stream is flushed at the end and not closed.
      Parameters:
      out - The stream
      Returns:
      Completes when the content was written
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the content was already consumed, or the part closed
      See Also:
      • FileUpload.transferTo(OutputStream)

    • takeBody

      CloseableByteBody takeBody()
      Take the content as a byte body: the caller becomes responsible for it. In a FormParts callback, the body must be consumed or closed before the stage returned by the callback completes: the next part cannot be read before the content of this one.
      Returns:
      The content
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the content was already consumed, or the part closed
      See Also:
      • FileUpload.takeBody()
